rows.definition: a bare 86400 on non-const lines in ~6 production files - always seconds-per-day (day formatting in cmd/fak loop/sweep/release_status, day math in releasestale/resume/repoguard), unambiguous but never named, so day-arithmetic sites cannot be found by search
gaps: hoist one secondsPerDay const into a shared time helper and point the day-formatting sites at it
